info.company: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd.

about: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd., investment holding company, develops skincare products in the People's Republic of China. It operates in two segments, Product Sales and Franchise Service. The company offers various products, such as basic skin physical protection, exfoliation, and sebum film repair to surface microecological balance, and anti-aging under the Park Ha brand. It sells products to customers through directly operated retail stores, and franchisees. The company has a strategic partnership with Star Plus Action (HK) Limited to build an AI-powered skincare and health ecosystem and expand its healthcare reach. Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. has strategic partnership with Cloud Factory Technology Holdings Limited to build ai-driven ecosystem for the beauty industry. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Wuxi, the People's Republic of China. Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Xiaoqiu Holding Ltd.
